title: 第149章 看得爽翻了！
slug: 综艺大导演从齐聚初代跑男开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

当画面来到驻马河北岸，看到节目组准备好的纸板和胶带时，弹幕里有人开始紧张了。

【渡江！这是乌江！他们要在霸王自刎的地方渡江！这是要替霸王渡江，重返江东吗？】

【横渡长江3.0版本要出现了吗！】

【期待期待！好刺激啊！】

随后吴凡站在码头边宣布规则。

四十五分钟造船倒计时开始。

辰鹤号、霸王号、牵鹿号、宝兰号……

当观众看到李辰的专业程度的时候都惊呆了。

什么船底三层纸板交叉叠压。

龙骨用卷紧的纸筒代替，船帮加高到小腿位置等等。

第一轮渡江，六艘船同时下水。

只有辰鹤号成功抵达对岸。

观众也是短暂地沉默了下来。

为兄弟团们感到可惜。

但没有人想到，第二轮造船的时候，李辰毫无保留地把自己的造船经验教给了所有人。

红队的人过来听，蓝队也没有赶他们走。

观众们也是感慨。

辰妈还是辰妈，一点都没变，时刻关心着大家。

第二轮渡江开始。

六艘重新造好的纸船再次下水，每一艘都比上一轮更厚实、更紧密、更像一艘真正的船。

辰鹤号依旧是第一个抵达南岸的。

但没有人想到，李辰站在南岸码头上，看着河面上还在和暗流漩涡搏斗的其他纸船，把刚脱下的救生衣重新扣回身上。

陈鹤站在他旁边，看了他一眼，只用了一秒就读懂了李辰的眼神。

和李辰并肩走到码头边缘。

两个人什么也没说，同时纵身跳进了驻马河。

河水冰凉。

李辰用最快的速度朝离南岸最近的霸王号游去。

看到这一幕的观众们都疯了。

【天呐，辰妈竟然跳下去了！简直不敢相信！】

【鹤哥竟然都跳下去了，看来真是认真了，这下我是真起鸡皮疙瘩了！】

【天呐，这才是跑男！这才是团魂！】

【燃哭了！我眼泪一下子就出来了！】

接下来每一个到岸的人，都会转身跳回水里，去帮助没有上岸的兄弟。

那个永不言弃、团结努力的跑男又回来了！

content_en:
Page (1/3)

When the screen came to the north bank of the Zhuma River and saw the cardboard and tape prepared by the program team, someone in the barrage began to get nervous.

【Cross the river!This is Wujiang!They want to cross the river where the overlord committed suicide!Is this to cross the river for the Overlord and return to Jiangdong?】

[Is version 3.0 of Crossing the Yangtze River coming soon?】

【Looking forward to it!So exciting!】

Wu Fan then stood by the dock and announced the rules.

The forty-five minute countdown to shipbuilding begins.

Chenhe, Bawang, Qianlu, Baolan...

The audience were shocked when they saw Li Chen's professionalism.

The bottom of the boat has three layers of cardboard criss-crossed.

The keel is replaced by a tightly rolled paper tube, the hull is raised to the calf position, etc.

The first boat crossed the river and six boats were launched at the same time.

Only the Chenkaku successfully reached the other side.

The audience also fell silent briefly.

Feeling sorry for the brothers.

But no one expected that during the second round of shipbuilding, Li Chen taught everyone his shipbuilding experience without reservation.

The people from the red team came to listen, but the blue team didn’t chase them away.

The audience was also emotional.

Chen Ma is still Chen Ma, she hasn’t changed at all, she always cares about everyone.

The second ferry crossing begins.

Six rebuilt paper boats were launched again, each one thicker, tighter and more like a real boat than the last one.

The Chenhe was still the first to arrive at the south bank.

But no one expected that Li Chen stood on the south bank pier, looking at the other paper boats still fighting against the undercurrent and whirlpools on the river, and put the life jacket he had just taken off back on his body.

Chen He stood next to him and glanced at him. It only took a second to understand Li Chen's eyes.

Walk side by side to the edge of the pier with Li Chen.

The two people said nothing and jumped into the Zhuma River at the same time.

The river is cold.

Li Chen swam towards the Overlord closest to the south bank at the fastest speed.

The audience who saw this scene went crazy.

[Oh my god, Chen Ma actually jumped down!I can't believe it!】

[Brother He actually jumped down. It seems he is really serious. I really got goosebumps now!】

[Oh my God, this is Running Man!This is the soul of the group!】

【Ran is crying!I burst into tears all of a sudden!】

Next, everyone who reaches the shore will turn around and jump back into the water to help the brothers who have not yet reached the shore.

The running man who never gives up and works together is back!
